baseline_kernel: Stock SGLang fused eager dual-stream Indexer with unquantized BF16 wq_b and BF16 wk_weights_proj; no replacement is enabled and stock remains the fallback

bottleneck.evidence: This supersedes glm52-prod--indexer-k-weights-prefill--b200--20260722a's full-region diagnosis: fixed_model_contract_cpu.json proves the pinned checkpoint uses BF16 wq_b, so the earlier FP8-wq trace with an activation-quant kernel is not production evidence. In exact_bf16_wq_range_analysis.json, the corrected stock four-kernel region has 99.392 us of kernels inside a 438.560 us projected GPU span, 339.168 us or 77.34% projected idle time, a 1.165776 ms host range, and zero cross-stream kernel overlap. Launch/dispatch gaps therefore dominate the corrected BF16-wq path independently of the invalidated FP8 trace.

approaches.summary: Resolve the pinned checkpoint tensor headers, quantization dispatch, and RoPE configuration before interpreting the earlier fused-region campaign.
approaches.why: The audit found BF16 wq_b and RoPE 1048576/8000000, so the old FP8-wq full-region, K-before-Q, and post-revert region measurements exercised the wrong executable graph and are retained only as superseded provenance.

approaches.summary: Replace only the BF16 wk_weights_proj call with the direct SM100 CuTe-DSL TGV backend in the corrected BF16-wq fused region.
approaches.why: The exact paired results in exact_bf16_wq/region_tgv_01.json through region_tgv_03.json are 0.568669x, 0.567336x, and 0.517108x, so every 60-pair repetition is a decisive regression.

approaches.summary: Replace functional linear with direct torch.mm while retaining the BF16 wq_b, official RoPE, streams, Q/gate outputs, and complete page-64 K-cache contract.
approaches.why: Corrected isolated results are 0.991200x, 0.981217x, and 0.997276x; corrected full-region results are 1.009863x, 0.980541x, and 0.997941x, with no repetition clearing the 1.03x gate.

approaches.summary: Disable the stock dual-stream branch for the corrected fixed-model region to test whether stream-management overhead outweighs intended overlap.
approaches.why: The three 60-pair results are 0.974558x, 1.201739x, and 0.971418x, so only one noisy repetition passes; exact_single_stream_range_analysis.json additionally shows 1.879x projected span and 1.475x host range versus matched stock.

approaches.summary: Retain only the isolated BF16 wk_weights_proj portion of the earlier FlashInfer auto, cuBLASLt, cuDNN, CUTLASS, and TGV sweep.
approaches.why: Those isolated rows do not construct wq_b or RoPE and remain valid, but every backend is slower at 0.109375x to 0.315262x; none warrants another corrected containing-region run.

lesson: Audit checkpoint quantization dispatch and model RoPE before profiling a fused serving region: a mathematically compatible FP8 reconstruction can insert a kernel that does not exist in production and invalidate the entire critical-path diagnosis. On the corrected BF16 lane, require repeat-stable containing-region gains plus stream-profile evidence; stock remains the only safe enable and fallback policy here.

caveats: This entry explicitly supersedes glm52-prod--indexer-k-weights-prefill--b200--20260722a for all full-region, stream-critical-path, and K-before-Q claims; only that entry's isolated BF16 wk_weights_proj and loader evidence remains transferable.
The corrected workload is a production-shaped rank-local invocation of the real unbound scheduling method, not a full model-module or eight-rank request.

The required TP8/DP8/EP8 production gate needs eight B200 GPUs and remains externally unavailable on this four-GPU host; it is not weakened or relabeled, and no candidate is enabled while it is unmet.
The fixed production recipe has indexer LoRA disabled, so no LoRA behavior is claimed.
